shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat slab
wings or wing-like feathered forms (A) vs none in B
justification: Both are shallow relief panels showing human figures rendered in strict profile with a raised arm gesture, and both use ruled horizontal lines that divide the field; these are generic conventions of profile-relief figural art. A shows a single colossal winged bearded figure filling the whole field with a bucket-like handled object, while B shows small-scale multi-figure scenes of seated and standing people around offering tables in two stacked registers, plus columns of script signs — a wholly different subject and composition.
